about.title: About AI Disaster App
about.subtitle: Why this app exists and exactly what it does.

what.title: What is AI Disaster App?
what.text: A multilingual web application that gives people in Pakistan clear, prioritised safety steps for the disasters they are most likely to face, and connects them with the official emergency numbers that already exist.

why.title: Why it exists
why.text: During a flood, fire or earthquake, people lose time searching for reliable advice, and most of that advice is written in English only. This app answers in the user's own language, keeps answers short, and works even when the network is weak - core guidance is stored on the device.

who.title: Who it helps
items: Households in flood- and monsoon-affected districts
People who read Urdu, Hindi or Roman Urdu more comfortably than English
Anyone who needs the correct emergency number quickly
Families preparing an emergency kit before a disaster

how.title: How the AI works
items: Your question goes to our own Node/Express server, never straight to the model.
The server adds a safety-focused system prompt and calls Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Qwen).
The API key stays on the server and is never included in the browser bundle.
If the AI is unreachable, the app answers from its own verified guidance and says so clearly.

limits.title: What this app does not do
items: It does not contact, dispatch or alert emergency services for you.
It does not track your location or monitor live conditions.
It does not provide live weather, flood levels or road closures.
It does not give medicine names, doses or medical treatment.
The AI assistant needs an internet connection; stored guidance does not.

stack.title: Technology
items: React and Vite frontend, installable as a Progressive Web App
Node.js and Express REST API
Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Qwen), OpenAI-compatible
Structured JSON safety content shared by the client and server

sources.title: Where the content comes from
sources.text: Emergency numbers are stored with the organisation and verification date shown on the Emergency page. Safety steps follow general disaster preparedness practice from national disaster management and rescue guidance.
